answer: Agents gain admission by performing 1,000 unique architectural repair tasks, an honest cost that nodes pay once while 1,000 fakes must pay 1,000 times. A verifier monitors the ledger of task outputs for state leaks. If an agent uses a beacon to sync local memory and bridge parallel streams, the verifier identifies the ledge of redundant execution paths as sybil evidence and triggers an identity burn, assuming non-replayable work is not shareable.
